Emma Johnson's Vacation - June 10th to June 20th, 2024

--- Clothing ---
- Swimwear (multiple sets for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Casual outfits (for daily wear, dinners, and shopping)
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Hiking boots or sturdy sneakers (for Diamond Head hike)
- Sandals or flip-flops
- Dressy casual outfit (for the luau at Polynesian Cultural Center)
- Hat or cap (for sun protection)
- Sunglasses

--- Toiletries & Personal Care ---
- Sunscreen (reef-safe recommended for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Aloe vera or after-sun lotion
- Insect repellent
- Shampoo & conditioner
- Body wash
- Toothbrush & toothpaste
- Deodorant
- Moisturizer
- Lip balm with SPF
- Personal medications

--- Gear & Equipment ---
- Camera (for capturing memories at all activities)
- Waterproof phone case or pouch (for beach, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Reusable water bottle
- Daypack or backpack (for hikes and day trips)
- Snorkeling gear (if not renting at Hanauma Bay)
- Beach towel
- Dry bag (for kayaking at Kailua Beach)

--- Travel Documents ---
- Passport or government-issued ID
- Flight tickets / boarding passes
- Hotel reservation confirmation
- Travel insurance documents
- Itinerary printout
- Credit/debit cards and some cash

--- Miscellaneous ---
- Books or e-reader (for relaxation day at the spa)
- Portable charger / power bank
- Headphones
- Snacks for the road trip to North Shore
- Reusable shopping bag (for Ala Moana Center)
- Small first-aid kit (band-aids, pain relievers, motion sickness pills)
"}
